options.content:
### How to use this dashboard

**Summary stats** (below) show at-a-glance health for the selected time range. Click **Failed Runs** to open the CI Investigation dashboard for detailed failure analysis.

**Filters:** **Job Type** narrows to specific CI jobs. **Outcome** toggles between Success, Failure, or both.

**Activity** -- pipeline run volume and success rate trends. **Duration** -- execution time envelope and retests per commit. **Steps & Infrastructure** -- step time breakdown and pod scheduling overhead. **Failure Patterns** -- which steps fail most and pod phase breakdown. **Cluster Pool** -- claim wait times, idle time, and install duration for Hive cluster pools. For individual build investigation, use the CI Investigation dashboard.

panels.title: Avg Retests / Commit
panels.description: Average number of pipeline runs per (PR, SHA) pair. Higher = more retries needed.

targets.expr: avg(sum by (pr_number, pr_sha) (count_over_time((group by (build_id, pr_number, pr_sha) (ci_test_platform_insights_additional_context_duration_seconds{name="execution_completed",job_name=~"$job_type",repo=~"$repo"}))[$__range:])))

panels.title: Active Pipelines
panels.description: Concurrent pipeline runs per bucket. Use to gauge cluster pool pressure.

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Percentage of pipeline runs that succeed. Drops indicate systemic issues or flaky tests.

panels.title: Pipeline Duration
panels.description: End-to-end execution time. Min/avg/max envelope shows spread.

panels.title: Retests per Commit
panels.description: How many times the same commit (pr+sha) runs the same job. High values = flaky tests or infra issues requiring retests.

targets.expr: max(sum by (pr_number, pr_sha) (count_over_time((group by (build_id, pr_number, pr_sha) (ci_test_platform_insights_additional_context_duration_seconds{name="execution_completed",success=~"$outcome",job_name=~"$job_type",repo=~"$repo"}))[$__interval:])))

avg(sum by (pr_number, pr_sha) (count_over_time((group by (build_id, pr_number, pr_sha) (ci_test_platform_insights_additional_context_duration_seconds{name="execution_completed",success=~"$outcome",job_name=~"$job_type",repo=~"$repo"}))[$__interval:])))

panels.title: Step Duration by Type
panels.description: Average duration of each ci-operator step. Identifies which steps dominate pipeline runtime.

panels.title: Infrastructure Overhead
panels.description: Pod scheduling and initialization latency. High values indicate cluster resource pressure.

panels.title: Step Failure Leaderboard
panels.description: Which ci-operator steps fail most often. High counts indicate flaky steps or infrastructure issues at specific phases.

panels.title: Pod Phase Breakdown
panels.description: Distribution of pod outcomes. High Failed ratio suggests infrastructure pressure.

panels.title: Avg Claim Wait
panels.description: Average time builds wait for a cluster from the pool. High values indicate pool saturation.

panels.title: Max Claim Wait
panels.description: Worst-case cluster claim wait time. Spikes indicate pool exhaustion.

panels.title: Avg Cluster Idle Time
panels.description: How long clusters sit idle in the pool before being claimed. Long idle times mean the pool is over-provisioned.

panels.title: Pool Claims
panels.description: Number of cluster claims in the selected time range.

panels.title: Claim Wait Time
panels.description: Cluster claim wait time trend. Rising wait times indicate growing pool contention.

panels.title: Cluster Lifecycle
panels.description: Install duration and idle time. Install duration is how long the cluster took to provision. Idle time is how long it sat in the pool before being claimed.

panels.title: Avg CPU Utilization
panels.description: Average worker node CPU utilization across Hive-claimed test clusters. Based on actual Prometheus TSDB data from the ephemeral clusters where e2e tests run.

panels.title: Avg Memory Utilization
panels.description: Average worker node memory utilization across Hive-claimed test clusters. Includes cache/buffers (reclaimable under pressure).

panels.title: Test Cluster CPU Usage vs Capacity
panels.description: CPU usage cores vs capacity across test clusters over time. Gap between lines shows headroom.

panels.title: Test Cluster Memory Usage vs Capacity
panels.description: Memory usage vs capacity across test clusters over time.

panels.title: Avg CPU Utilization
panels.description: Average CPU utilization across build cluster nodes. These are the shared CI infrastructure nodes where ci-operator runs, not the test clusters.

panels.title: Avg Memory Utilization
panels.description: Average memory utilization across build cluster nodes.

panels.title: Node CPU Utilization
panels.description: CPU utilization per build cluster node over time.

panels.title: Node Memory Utilization
panels.description: Memory utilization per build cluster node over time.
